## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.2718 (spec 0.2759), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://static-mpm-optimized.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/20cab2f8-a49d-4f2b-9278-55f9834283b8_xlarge.png (Mobile Phone Museum, phone-detail/sony-ericsson-z600; the raised lid straightened, the inventory sticker painted out)) by Mobile Phone Museum; geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.mobilephonemuseum.com/phone-detail/sony-ericsson-z600) by Mobile Phone Museum; specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_z600-524.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/z600/).
